title: "Java Memory Model (JMM)"

::: {.callout-note}
## Outline only

This section is a **knowledge map**, not a complete textbook. Fill in each chapter gradually using one consistent running example, verified specifications, code, and interactive experiments.
:::

**Specification baseline:** Java SE 27 (September 2026). The Java Memory Model (JMM) concerns permitted behaviour of shared-memory interactions, not the physical heap/stack layout of a particular JVM.

## Writing convention

Each topic will start with a concrete problem, reuse the same example as far as possible, derive the guarantees before introducing terminology, and then add an interactive experiment or executable test.
